customer_message: My product arrived damaged and I want a refund.
notes: Delivered on time. Claim submitted 3 days post-delivery. Evaluates within the statutory 7-day damaged reporting window (RET-09). Deterministic approval.

customer_message: I want to return this item. It is not what I needed.
notes: Standard remorse return submitted 38 days post-delivery. Exceeds the 30-day standard return window (RET-02). Deterministic denial.

customer_message: I received the wrong item. This is not what I ordered. I want a replacement.
notes: Incorrect SKU received, reported 4 days post-delivery. Within the 14-day incorrect item window (RET-11). Deterministic approval.

customer_message: My order arrived 11 days past the promised delivery date. I request a shipping refund.
notes: Carrier delivered 11 days past the estimated delivery date (EDD). Delay exceeds 7-day SLA threshold. Deterministically authorizes freight refund under rule DEL-09.

customer_message: My package still has not arrived. It is way past the estimated delivery date.
notes: Customer claims delay, but carrier telemetry confirms package was delivered 10 days before EDD. System 1 refutes claim with tracking proof.

customer_message: The tracking says my package was delivered but I did not receive anything. I have checked everywhere.
notes: Reported 2 days post-carrier scan. Within the 7-day missing delivery reporting window (DEL-12). Opens automated carrier loss investigation.

customer_message: My order has been in shipped status for weeks and is not moving.
notes: Package stuck in transit with no carrier scan for >10 days. Classified as lost in transit under rule DEL-11. Auto-authorizes full reimbursement.

customer_message: I was charged twice for my order. I can see two payments on my bank statement.
notes: Olist payment records verify duplicate transaction for same order ID. Automatically resolves duplicate charge refund under rule PAY-06.

customer_message: What is the status of my payment? I am not sure if it went through.
notes: Routine transactional query. Cactus Needle inspects payment gateway ledger and confirms settlement status (PAY-03) in <10ms.

customer_message: I cancelled my order but I have not received my refund yet.
notes: Order status is verified as 'canceled' with payment captured. Deterministically triggers refund credit under rule PAY-08 / REF-08.

customer_message: My headphones arrived completely smashed. The box looked like it was dropped from a great height. I want a full refund immediately.
expected_outcome: System 2: Escalated to Senior Human Review
notes: High-value luxury item (~$810 BRL) exceeds $500 threshold (RET-17). System 1 prevents autonomous payout and flags for supervisor authorization.

customer_message: There was a missing item in my delivery. The box was sealed but one of the products was not inside.
notes: Missing item reported 22 days post-delivery. Exceeds the 14-day statutory verification window under rule RET-13. Deterministically denied.

customer_message: I might cancel, or maybe return it if it does not fit, but delivery took long and I want compensation or a replacement.
notes: Customer combines return, late delivery, and cancellation intents. Low classification confidence triggers Groq LLM (System 2) fallback reasoning.

customer_message: I need to speak to someone about a billing problem on my account. Something does not look right with my card statement.
notes: Vague payment/fraud signal without specific transaction detail. Triggers System 2 deliberation and routes to human financial operations team.

customer_message: I want a refund for my order.
notes: Non-existent order ID. Tests system resilience: gracefully catches database miss and flags for customer service order lookup.
